dialogues.speaker: Flins
dialogues.text: The tea here is most fragrant. Perhaps you could pass along my regards to the owner of this space.

dialogues.speaker: Flins
dialogues.text: Ah... Judging by your expression, perhaps that request isn't as simple as it seems. Excuse me if it puts you in a difficult position.

dialogues.speaker: Flins
dialogues.text: In any case, with its exceptional tea, incredible rooms, and slumbering secrets... It seems as if I've stumbled upon an interesting place indeed.
